_comment: TDD M4 read slice: Gemini discovery accepts the documented ?key= credential while other ingresses use headers only. RED on baseline (no list).
name: m4_read_api_gemini_key_query
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "required"
api_keys = ["client-secret"]
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"
